text: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":475598,"ns":0,"title":"Ecological fallacy","extract":"An ecological fallacy (also ecological inference fallacy or population fallacy) is a formal fallacy in the interpretation of statistical data that occurs when inferences about the nature of individuals are deduced from inferences about the group to which those individuals belong. \"Ecological fallacy\" is a term that is sometimes used to describe the fallacy of division, which is not a statistical fallacy.","description":"Formal fallacy in statistical interpretation","descriptionsource":"local"}]}}
